verdict.rationale: Vue's official site links to a page titled "Get Security Updates for Vue 2" and a "Migration from Vue 2" guide. That points to a documented route for keeping an older major version secure while migrating, but the evidence is only a navigation title, with no detail on who provides the updates, terms, scope or duration. missing for 10: details of the security-update offering (provider, scope, support window, cost), any documented LTS/EOL policy for older majors, independent or hands-on corroboration that patches are actually delivered.

support.subject: As a developer, I can continue receiving security updates for an older major version while I plan my migration
